jobs.occupation: KU Leuven M&N Core Facility Manager
jobs.description:
As the Manager of the M&N FAB Core Facility, you will be responsible for the technical and operational management of the facility. jobs.occupation: Become a Multilingual Customer Service Officer (French-Dutch-English, Night Shifts) in a Multicultur
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you play a crucial role in a multicultural and multilingual helpdesk. You are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You handle incoming calls and emails and ensure that every customer receives fast and professional assistance. You also communicate with repair shops and technical partners to coordinate interventions and keep customers fully informed.

Your workday starts with a short team meeting, after which you and your colleagues are ready for incoming calls. You accurately collect information, check data for completeness, and enter everything into the system. You juggle multiple tasks: contacting emergency services, following up on contractual agreements, and updating files. You work independently but can always rely on the support of your team lead and coworkers.

Are you solution-oriented, stress-resistant, and do you love variety? Then this job is perfect for you! You'll get to use your language skills, collaborate with people from all over Europe, and learn something new every day. Apply now and make a real difference for our customers!

• You can multitask and work accurately, even under stress

• Technical knowledge of automotive is a plus, not a must

• No experience required – motivation and willingness to learn are most important

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Become a Forklift Operator at a Sustainable Recycling Company
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you’ll join an innovative plastic recycling company where sustainability and circular economy are at the heart of what we do. In this role, you’ll be responsible for moving plastic waste around the site, loading and unloading trucks, and performing minor technical maintenance. Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. You’ll use a wheel loader and forklift to efficiently process plastic waste. Flexibility is important, as the shift schedule can vary slightly. Please note, the nature of recycling means the work environment can be less clean and sometimes involve odors. You’ll handle small technical issues yourself, while a maintenance technician is available for larger problems.

Are you ready to put your technical skills to good use and make a positive impact on the environment? Apply now and make a difference as an operator in the recycling industry!

• You have a valid forklift license

• You speak good English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

• You work accurately and value safety

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. 

Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.

The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your Role
As a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your Profile
We are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.
